items.name: 失智术
items.description:
你大幅削弱目标的心智能力。目标必须尝试意志豁免。该诅咒的效果只能通过以诅咒为目标的效果移除。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}，持续1轮。

失败目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞4}，持续时间无限。

大失败目标的智能永久降低至不及动物的程度，其魅力、智力和感知调整值均视为–5。它失去所有需要心智能力的职业能力，包括全部施法能力。如果目标是PC，它会成为由GM控制的NPC。
items.expectedDescription:
You drastically reduce the target's mental faculties. The target must attempt a Will save. The effects of this curse can be removed only through effects that target curses.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4} with an unlimited duration.

Critical Failure The target's intellect is permanently reduced below that of an animal, and it treats its Charisma, Intelligence, and Wisdom modifiers as –5. It loses all class abilities that require mental faculties, including all spellcasting. If the target is a PC, they become an NPC under the GM's control.

items.name: 念动绞扼
items.description: 你以念动之力如虎钳般紧握一个生物的咽喉或类似的致命部位，强行将其提离地面数英寸，使其挣扎着呼吸。对抗目标的AC进行远程法术攻击。命中时，你造成6d12钝击伤害，目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}状态。以这种方式禁足期间，它必须屏息，否则便开始窒息。每轮你首次维持该法术时，目标受到1d12钝击伤害，仍然禁足，并必须继续屏息。目标可以尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{逃脱}（逃脱DC为你的法术DC，且此次尝试受到失能特征影响）。
items.expectedDescription: You telekinetically grasp a creature's throat or similar vital anatomy with a vicelike grip, forcefully lifting it a few inches off the ground as it struggles to breathe. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d12 bludgeoning damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}. While immobilized in this way, it must hold its breath or begin suffocating. The first time each round you Sustain the spell, the target takes 1d12 bludgeoning damage, remains immobilized, and must continue holding its breath. The target can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} (the Escape DC is your spell DC, and the attempt is affected by the incapacitation trait).

items.name: 幽影爆破
items.description:
区域可变

防御@Check[reflex|basic|options:area-effect]或@Check[will|basic|options:area-effect]（由目标选择）

你将影界的幽影物质塑造成一道爆发。选择@Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[acid]|options:area-damage]、@Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage]、@Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[cold]|options:area-damage]、@Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[electricity]|options:area-damage]、@Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[fire]|options:area-damage]、@Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[force]|options:area-damage]、@Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[piercing]|options:area-damage]、@Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[slashing]|options:area-damage]、@Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[sonic]|options:area-damage]或@Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[spirit]|options:area-damage]伤害，再选择@Template[cone|distance:30]、120尺内的一处@Template[burst|distance:15]或@Template[line|distance:50]。该爆发对区域内每个生物造成6d8点所选类型的伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d8。
items.expectedDescription:
Area varies

Defense @Check[reflex|basic|options:area-effect] or @Check[will|basic|options:area-effect] (target's choice)

You shape the shadow substance of the Netherworld into a blast. Choose @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[acid]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[cold]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[electricity]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[fire]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[force]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[piercing]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[slashing]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[sonic]|options:area-damage], or @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[spirit]|options:area-damage] damage, and choose a @Template[cone|distance:30], a @Template[burst|distance:15] within 120 feet, or a @Template[line|distance:50]. The blast deals 6d8 damage of the type you chose to each creature in the area.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.

items.name: 神经脉冲
items.description:
你释放出一道搏动的精神冲击，穿透区域内所有敌人的心智。区域内每个敌人都必须尝试意志豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}状态。

失败该生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑2}状态。

大失败该生物震慑，持续1轮。
items.expectedDescription:
You emit a pulsating mental blast that penetrates the minds of all enemies in the area. Each enemy in the area must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is Stunned for 1 round.

items.name: 极潮绝望
items.description:
你使区域内的生物陷入绝望。每个生物受到的效应取决于其意志豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功1轮内，该生物不能使用反应，并且必须在自己回合开始时再次进行豁免；失败时，它因无法控制的啜泣，在该回合内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}状态。

失败如同成功，但持续时间为1分钟。

大失败如同失败，且该生物自动陷入缓慢1，持续1分钟。

升阶（7环）区域扩大至60尺锥形。
items.expectedDescription:
You inflict despair on creatures in the area. The effects for each creature are determined by its Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success For 1 round, the creature can't use reactions and must attempt another save at the start of its turn; on a failure, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is automatically slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Heightened (7th) The area increases to a 60-foot cone.

items.name: 修订记忆
items.description:
你改变目标的记忆，可以抹除一段记忆、使一段记忆更加清晰、修改一段记忆，或添加一段虚假记忆。目标可以进行意志豁免抵抗法术。

大成功目标不受影响，并意识到你尝试改变其记忆。

成功目标不受影响，却认为你的法术是无害的其他法术，而非修订记忆，除非它辨识出该法术。

失败在法术持续时间的最初5分钟内，你可以通过维持该法术，每轮修改一次记忆。每次如此做时，你想象出至多6秒的记忆并加以修改，最多可修改连续5分钟的记忆。

只要法术仍在生效，你修改过的记忆就会保持改变后的样子。如果目标在5分钟结束前移出射程，你就无法继续修改记忆。

升阶（6环）你可以对一个自愿目标施放该法术，压制其关于某个特定主题的全部记忆；该主题须以不超过50个词描述。此效果永久持续，并用一片模糊的迷雾填补被抹去的记忆。
items.expectedDescription:
You alter the target's memories by erasing a memory, enhancing a memory's clarity, altering a memory, or adding a false memory. The target can attempt a Will save to resist the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and realizes you tried to alter its memory.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of rewrite memory, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure During the first 5 minutes of the spell's duration, you can Sustain the spell to modify a memory once each round. When you do, you imagine up to 6 seconds of memory to modify, to a maximum of 5 continuous minutes of memory.

Any memories you've altered remain changed as long as the spell is active. If the target moves out of range before the 5 minutes is up, you can't alter any further memories.

Heightened (6th) You can Cast the Spell on a willing target to suppress all memory of a particular topic, detailed in 50 words or fewer. The effect is permanent, and it patches these omissions with an indistinct haze.

items.name: 次元移位
items.description:
你将自己以及穿戴和持握的物品，立即从当前空间传送至射程内一个能看见的未占据空间。如果这会带着另一个生物同行，即使该生物被装在异次元容器中，法术也会失效。

升阶（5环）射程提高至1里。你不必看见目的地，只要曾经到过那里，并知道其与你的相对位置和距离。之后，你暂时免疫1小时。
items.expectedDescription:
You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

items.name: 分析目标
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.

items.name: 晕眩术
items.description:
你侵入目标的心智，以精神冲击使其晕眩。这道冲击造成1d6心灵伤害，目标进行基础意志豁免。如果目标豁免大失败，它还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}。

升阶（+2）伤害增加1d6。
items.expectedDescription:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

items.name: 植入数据
items.description:
你重新编程一台计算机或设备，使其在被访问时显示一条选定的数据。你每个法术环级至多可以植入一条数据。一条数据可以是一项简单事实，例如某个生物或物体的位置或外貌描述；一幅生物或物体的图像；或一句不超过300个字符的简单陈述。目标计算机或设备被访问时，访问者首先获得的总是这条植入数据，无论该生物在寻找什么数据。植入数据不会阻止生物访问设备储存的其他信息，不会改变设备的运作方式，也不会以其他方式妨碍其运作。如果法术持续时间在生物访问植入数据前结束，这些信息便消失。

升阶（3环）持续时间为一年。

升阶（6环）持续时间为无限。
items.expectedDescription:
You reprogram a computer or device to display a chosen piece of data when accessed. You can implant up to one piece of data per spell rank. A piece of data can be a simple fact, such as a creature or object's location or physical description; an image of a creature or object; or a simple statement of no more than 300 characters. When the target computer or device is accessed, this implanted data is the first data the accessing creature gains, regardless of what data the creature is looking for. Implanted data doesn't prevent a creature from accessing other information stored on a device, change how the device functions, or otherwise inhibit the device from functioning. If this spell's duration ends before a creature accesses the implanted data, the information vanishes.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is one year.

Heightened (6th) The duration is unlimited.

items.name: 寻觅星辰
items.description:
在你的脑海中，你绘制了一条穿越宇宙的路径。如果你在协约世界的空间中，你就能立刻知道前往星石和艾巴萨罗姆空间站的方向。如果你在协约世界以外的空间，你会知道前往最近的漂流信标或星石的方向。

升阶（7环）你可以知道前往熟悉地点的方向，例如你曾经去过的世界或中转站。
items.expectedDescription:
In your mind's eye, you chart a path through the cosmos. If you're in Pact Worlds space, you immediately know which direction to travel in order to reach the Starstone on Absalom Station. If you're outside the Pact System, you know the direction to the nearest Drift beacon or the Starstone.

Heightened (7th) You can instead know the direction to a familiar location, such as a world or way station you've visited.

items.name: 念动射弹
items.description:
你将射程内一件未固定、无人持有且负载不超过1的物体掷向目标。对目标进行法术攻击检定。命中时，你造成2d6钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害，取决于所掷物体。被掷物品的任何特殊特征或魔法属性，都不会影响此次攻击或伤害。

大成功你造成双倍伤害。

成功你造成完整伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。
items.expectedDescription:
You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

items.name: 飞行术
items.description:
目标能在空中翱翔，获得等于其速度或20尺的飞行速度，取较高者。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.MuRBCiZn5IKeaoxi]{法术效果：飞行术}

升阶（7环）持续时间增至1小时。
items.expectedDescription:
The target can soar through the air, gaining a fly Speed equal to its Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.MuRBCiZn5IKeaoxi]{Spell Effect: Fly}

Heightened (7th) The duration increases to 1 hour.

items.name: 运动感知
items.description: 帕利瓦尔能通过移动引起的空气或水中振动，在列出的距离内以不精确感官感知附近的生物。
items.expectedDescription: Palivhar can sense nearby creatures through vibrations in air or water caused by movement as an imprecise sense at the listed range.

items.name: 桑迪特水晶学识
items.description: 帕利瓦尔能以+18调整值，对任何主题进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}
items.expectedDescription: Palivhar can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} on any subject with a +18 modifier

items.name: 虫群心智
items.description: （灵光） 30尺。所有处于彼此范围内的虫群心智盟友能够进行持续的心灵沟通，并且彼此知道对方察觉到的所有威胁。如果此生物处于至少一个具有虫群心智的盟友的范围内，则其在对抗心灵效果的豁免上掷骰出成功时，改为获得大成功。
items.expectedDescription: 30 feet. All allies with colony mind within the listed range of each other are in constant telepathic communication and are aware of all threats any individual knows about. While within range of at least one ally with colony mind, when a creature rolls a success on a save against a mental effect, it gets a critical success instead.

items.name: 决意
items.description: 帕利瓦尔的意志豁免大失败时，改为失败。
items.expectedDescription: When Palivhar rolls a critical failure on a Will save, they get a failure instead.

items.expectedName: +1 Circumstance to All Saves vs. Mental Effects
items.name: 对抗心灵效应的所有豁免获得+1环境加值
桑迪特脉冲
items.description: 当帕利瓦尔以桑迪特矛打击对一个非无心智敌人造成伤害时，会向其心灵发送一阵随机事实与记忆的脉冲。目标必须成功通过@Check[will|dc:30]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}状态，持续1轮。
items.expectedDescription: When Palivhar deals damage to a non-mindless foe with their szandite spear Strike, they send a pulse of random facts and memories to the mind of the creature. The target must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:30] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round.

items.name: 桑迪特共鸣
items.description: 帕利瓦尔与房间内的水晶方尖碑（区域Q17）共鸣，使其释放一道动能魔法冲击。水晶方尖碑周围15尺内所有不具有虫族特征的生物受到@Damage[12d6[force]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic]豁免）。帕利瓦尔在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Szandite Resonance]]{1d4轮}内不能再次使用桑迪特共鸣。
items.expectedDescription: Palivhar resonates with the crystal obelisks in the room (area Q17), causing them to emit a blast of kinetic magical energy. All non-kucharn creatures within 15 feet of a crystal obelisk take @Damage[12d6[force]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save). Palivhar can't use Szandite Resonance again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Szandite Resonance]]{1d4 rounds}.

cnText_system_attributes_allSaves_value.expected: +1 circumstance bonus to saves vs. mental effects
cnText_system_attributes_allSaves_value.text: 对抗心灵效果的豁免获得+1环境加值

items.name: 短刀
items.description:
强化： 1

刀兼具武器和工具价值，有各种形状和样式，材料则从星金到陶瓷不一而足。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Invaluable as both a weapon and a tool, knives come in a variety of shapes, styles, and materials ranging from starmetals to ceramics.

items.name: 半自动手枪
items.description:
强化： 1

此手枪每次射击后都会自动抛出空弹壳，并装填新弹药。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This pistol automatically ejects used cartridges and loads new ammunition after every shot fired.

items.name: 偏斜力场
items.description: 这种盾牌并非需要持握——它会作为升级模块被安装在护甲或武器内。偏斜力场看起来如同一个集成到被升级的物品中的半透明面板，并在激活时创造出一个临时的保护性光盾。
items.expectedDescription: This shield isn't held—instead, it's installed as an armor or weapon upgrade. A deflecting field appears as a translucent panel integrated into the upgraded item and creates a temporary protective hardlight barrier when activated.

items.name: 微纤护甲
items.description:
强化： 1

此轻甲以超轻纤维编织，随穿戴者的动作弯曲，但受到冲击时会硬如钢铁。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

8gzjwW9MmZkXUmWV.name: 突变堡垒虫 Mutant Bastorox
8gzjwW9MmZkXUmWV.publicNotes:
令人畏惧的堡垒虫是活体有机壁垒，用巨大的几丁质盾牌偏转伤害，同时向敌人释放生物电脉冲。它们为克雷西斯卡子群中不断推进的成员守住阵地，例如数量众多、行动敏捷的战斗虫。这些生物巨兽只是克雷西斯卡子群队伍中新出现的演化成果之一；在围攻罗德纳斯期间，它们曾坚定地推进，穿过这颗星球危机四伏的沼泽。

虫群由浩界深处一种称为虫族的虫类物种演化而来，被数种文明视为现存最大的威胁。虫群由无数子群组成，每个子群又包含无数成员亚种；这支庞大群体以心灵联合行动，意图吞噬宇宙中的所有物质。最可怕的是，虫群能够同化被吞噬者的知识与DNA。虫群在大断层前就已发展出星际旅行，因此在历史中断之前便已吞噬无数星系；获得信标和名为漂流域的超空间维度的使用途径后，它们扩张的速度只增不减。

虫群触及的世界会被榨干自然资源，沦为称作空壳世界的荒芜之地。外界所谓的“虫群疆域”，不过是虫群肆意扩张过程中吞噬的一片死寂世界。虫群对这些世界搜刮得如此彻底，以至于勘察者连稀有矿物和水等无机资源的痕量残留都难以找到。这些空壳世界很少被彻底探索，因为探索往往会唤醒休眠的虫群成员；有人推测，它们被留下是为了应对被吞噬星系再次遭到殖民、重新繁荣的可能。虫群活动的零星区域远在这片宙域之外也有分布，因为虫群在大断层前的漫长岁月里曾派出无数子群，直到今日，也只有一部分抵达了预定目的地。

在当代，虫群最广为人知的或许是两个重要事实。其一，它们对协约世界与维斯卡里姆的进攻，促使这两大势力停止敌对，并建立了脆弱的联盟。其二，虫群是希伦虫人物种的直系祖先。希伦虫人在大断层期间的某个时候脱离虫群，并得到了女神海拉丝的庇护。人们认为，海拉丝由虫群出现前的虫族演化而来，并背弃了虫群演化成的贪食实体。

近些年来，除了在浩界的苏斯基隆星系开展的机密行动之外，虫群几乎没有活动，因而被视为遥远的恐怖传说。然而，最近失落的桑迪特世界克雷西斯卡被重新发现，却无意间唤醒了曾吞噬该世界、随后休眠的子群。从那以后，这支新命名为克雷西斯卡子群的虫群便成为近宇的灾祸，正积极入侵桑迪特联合体的各个世界，并随时可能波及维斯卡里姆和协约世界等其他势力。重新现身的子群已开始迅速演化其成员，且仍与更广大的虫群隔绝，但依然对近宇构成明确威胁。

长冠达洛克兽是原产于罗德纳斯沼泽湿地的巨型爬行野兽。达洛克兽独居且领地意识强烈，一年中大部分时间都在浑浊的沼泽中游泳、晒太阳，避免接触同类。然而，它们每年都会暂时放下独居习性，组成庞大的兽群，深入沼泽寻找有遮蔽的水域，作为产卵池。

JIlEQENIwjxypy2x.publicNotes:
罗德纳斯行星的沼泽以环境险恶著称，常遭受各种极端天气事件，从富含硫磺的水道骤然燃起火风暴，到致命气体无形地聚集，无所不有。

罗德纳斯的动植物也演化得同样极端，曼诺克兽便是其中一例，其名称在罗德纳斯语中意为“食火者”。曼诺克兽是植物状生物，以沼泽中频发的火风暴为食，将产生的化学物质转化为自身的汁液和果实。它们激烈的繁殖方式常被误认为是攻击行为：它们不会诱使动物吃下果实来传播种子，而是在侦测到移动时射出爆炸果实。命中目标后，李子般的果实爆裂，喷出黏稠的腐蚀汁液。受害者试图逃离时，汁液中的种子会逐渐落下并发芽。

虽然它们表现出一些粗浅的语言理解能力，但只有最勇敢（或最幸运）的博物学家才能与这些生物达成一定共识，最常见的方式是用化学营养物换取和平采摘果实的机会。

items.name: 阿卡西下载（随意）
items.description:
你通过灵能搜索阿卡西记录，获取特定主题的信息，并将数据魔法传输至通讯单元或计算机。施放此法术时，选择任何你至少为受训熟练度且能进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]动作的技能。

在持续时间内的任何时候，你都可以在使用所选技能进行回忆知识检定时查询通讯单元。该检定会获得+1状态加值。检查通讯单元是回忆知识动作的一部分。你必须手持通讯单元才能这样做。通讯单元会立即编译并显示与主题相关的各种媒体片段和精选内容，从而为你带来加值。如果你在检定中掷出大失败，改为失败。如果检定成功，且对象是生物，你将获得有关该生物的额外信息或内容。一旦你查询了通讯单元的信息，法术就会结束。当法术结束时，你对阿卡西记录的访问也会结束，你下载的所有信息都会返回阿卡西记录。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

升阶（3环）法术结束前可以用通讯单元查询信息3次。
items.expectedDescription:
You execute a psychic search of the Akashic Record for information about a specific topic and magically transfer this data to your comm unit or computer. When you Cast this Spell, choose any skill in which you're trained that has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} action.

Any time during the duration, you can consult your comm unit while attempting a Recall Knowledge check using your chosen skill. This check gains a +1 status bonus. Checking your comm unit is part of the action to Recall Knowledge. You must be holding the comm unit to do so. The comm unit instantly compiles and displays snippets and selections from various media relevant to the topic, which grants you the bonus. If you roll a critical failure on this check, you get a failure instead. If the check is successful and the subject is a creature, you gain additional information or context about the creature. Once you reference the comm unit, the spell ends. When the spell ends, your access to the Akashic Record ends, and all the information you downloaded returns to the Akashic Record.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

Heightened (3rd) You can reference your comm unit three times before the spell ends.

extraFields.expected: You have a comm unit or computer, used as a locus.
extraFields.text: 你持有通讯装置或计算机，用作施法载体。

items.name: 腹语术
items.description:
每当你说话或以嗓音发出其他声音时，都可以使声音听起来像来自60尺内的其他位置；发声时，你可以自由改变这个表面上的声源位置。任何听到声音的生物都可以尝试识破你的幻术。

升阶（2环）法术持续时间增至1小时，你还能改变自己的音调、音质及声音的其他特征。生物必须先主动尝试察觉检定，或以其他方式花费动作与声音互动，才能尝试识破你的幻术。
items.expectedDescription:
Whenever you speak or make any other sound vocally, you can make your vocalization seem to originate from somewhere else within 60 feet, and you can change that apparent location freely as you vocalize. Any creature that hears the sound can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (2nd) The spell's duration increases to 1 hour, and you can also change the tone, quality, and other aspects of your voice. Before a creature can attempt to disbelieve your illusion, it must actively attempt a Perception check or otherwise use actions to interact with the sound.

items.name: 阿卡西之眼
items.description: 阿卡西龙可以从阿卡西记录中查明信息，而非使用自身记忆。这赋予它阿卡西记录学识技能，能用来进行任意类别的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}。
items.expectedDescription: Instead of using their own memories, an Akashic dragon can ascertain information from the Akashic Records. This gives it the Akashic Record Lore skill, which it can use to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} of any kind.

items.expectedName: +2 Status to All Saves vs. Occult
items.name: 对抗异能的所有豁免获得+2状态加值
阿卡西干扰
items.description:
90尺。阿卡西龙附近不断上传与下载的信息涡流，使尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}变得难以预测。除阿卡西龙外，进入区域或在区域内开始其回合的生物必须进行@Check[will|dc:28]豁免。无论豁免结果如何，该生物都会暂时免疫此龙的阿卡西干扰1分钟。

大成功1轮内，该生物尝试回忆知识时，检定获得+3状态加值。

成功该生物不受影响。

失败1轮内，该生物尝试回忆知识时，检定受到–3状态减值。

大失败如同失败，但效应持续1分钟。
items.expectedDescription:
90 feet. The swirl of constant uploads and downloads near the Akashic dragon make attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} unpredictable. A creature other than an akashic dragon that enters or begins its turn in the area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:28] save. Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to this dragon's Akashic interference for 1 minute.

Critical Success For 1 round, when the creature attempts to Recall Knowledge, it gains a +3 status bonus to its check.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For 1 round, when the creature attempts to Recall Knowledge, it takes a –3 status penalty to its check.

Critical Failure As failure, but the effect lasts 1 minute.

items.name: 偏转激光
items.description:
触发该龙被一次攻击重击

效果阿卡西龙利用遍布全身的眼睛，展开一道偏转激光网，对抗触发攻击的所有伤害获得抗力15，并吸收部分攻击能量，使阿卡西弹幕重新充能。如果阿卡西龙在过去1分钟内对该生物成功进行过@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}检定，则改为获得抗力20。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The dragon is critically hit by an attack

Effect The Akashic dragon raises a web of deflecting lasers using the eyes embedded all over their body, gaining resistance 15 to all damage against the triggering attack and absorbing some of the blow's energy, recharging their Akashic Barrage. If the Akashic dragon has succeeded at a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check against the creature in the last minute, they gain resistance 20 instead.

items.name: 阿卡西适应性
items.description: 阿卡西龙能够启动以任意流派的施放法术作为启动方式的魔法及科技物品，如同其中包含的法术是异能法术一般。
items.expectedDescription: The Akashic dragon can activate magic and tech items with the Cast a Spell activation of any tradition as if the spells they contain were occult spells.

items.name: 阿卡西弹幕
items.description: 巨龙将阿卡西记录中锐利的真理和炽烈的启示凝聚为灼热激光，从主眼投射成锥形，袭击敌人。这会造成@Damage[14d6[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害，范围为@Template[type:cone|distance:30]（@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:stupefied]豁免）。如果一个生物对抗阿卡西弹幕的反射豁免大失败，且阿卡西龙在过去1分钟内曾对该生物成功进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}检定，则该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}状态，持续1轮。巨龙在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Akashic Barrage]]{1d4轮}内不能再次使用阿卡西弹幕。
items.expectedDescription: The dragon condenses cutting truths and fiery revelations from the Akashic Record into sizzling laser fire that they project as a cone from their primary eye to assail their foes. This deals @Damage[14d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] (@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:stupefied] save). If a creature critically fails its Reflex save against Akashic Barrage and the Akashic dragon has succeeded at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about the creature in the last minute, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round. The dragon can't use Akashic Barrage again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Akashic Barrage]]{1d4 rounds}.

items.name: 变化形体
items.description:
特伦拉多拉莉丝变为任意小型或中型类人生物的外观。这不会改变她的速度，或打击的攻击与伤害加值，但可能改变打击造成的伤害类型（通常变为钝击）。

items.name: 敌人档案

items.expectedDescription: The first time each encounter the Akashic dragon hits and deals damage to a creature with their jaws Strike, they receive information about the creature as if they'd succeeded at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about that creature.

items.name: 惊人揭示
items.description:
需求巨龙在过去1分钟内曾对90尺内一个敌人成功进行回忆知识

效果巨龙说出关于该生物的一项惊人真相，连该生物自己可能都不知道，使它及其盟友犹豫不决或举止失常。90尺内所有能听见该秘密的敌人都必须进行@Check[will|dc:31|options:area-effect,inflicts:slowed]豁免。之后，每个生物免疫惊人揭示24小时。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}状态，持续1轮。

失败该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢2}，持续1轮。

大失败该生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}状态，持续1轮。
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The dragon has successfully Recalled Knowledge about an enemy within 90 feet within the last minute

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round.

Ty3klzUHoVkfwAee.name: 特伦拉多拉莉丝 Trenladoralis
Ty3klzUHoVkfwAee.publicNotes: 虽然人们很少在阿卡西龙那满是遗物、日渐坍塌的巢穴之外遇到它们，但这些龙偶尔也会居住在知识汇聚之地，例如繁忙的空间站或城市。这些巨龙与阿卡西记录有着直接联系，是傲慢的知识管理者，认为其他生物不可能比自己更深刻地理解宇宙的奥秘——而这往往确实如此。阿卡西龙会花费大量时间待在阿卡西记录中，常以为自己度过了许多天，出来后却发现银河系其他地方只过去了几小时。

items.name: 次元移位
items.description:
你将自己以及穿戴和持握的物品，立即从当前空间传送至射程内一个能看见的未占据空间。如果这会带着另一个生物同行，即使该生物被装在异次元容器中，法术也会失效。

升阶（5环）射程提高至1里。你不必看见目的地，只要曾经到过那里，并知道其与你的相对位置和距离。之后，你暂时免疫1小时。
items.expectedDescription:
You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

items.name: 锐耳术
items.description: 你在射程内一个位置创造一只@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}的悬浮耳朵（即使在你的视线或效应线之外）。它不能移动，但你能如同使用正常听觉感官般，通过耳朵听见声音。

It can't move, but you can hear through the ear as if using your normal auditory senses.

items.expectedDescription:

Valued as both a crafting tool and an effective weapon, this hammer uses specially weighted heads and handles to deliver maximum force with each strike.

items.name: 绊脚
items.description:
触发船栖精群所占空间内的一个生物尝试移动至未被船栖精群占据的空间

效果船栖精挡住去路，试图绊倒目标。触发生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}状态，除非成功通过@Check[reflex|dc:25]豁免。
items.expectedDescription:

Shiptreeks only have access to their innate spellcasting while inside their bonded ship. For the purpose of casting translocate, the shiptreek is considered to be able to see everywhere within its bonded ship.

items.expectedDescription: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes @Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] save) plus efficient dismantling

items.description:
目标能理解所有语言的言辞，也能说其他生物的语言。身处一群使用不同语言的生物中时，目标每次说话都可以选择一个生物，使用该生物理解的语言讲话，即使目标不知道那是什么语言。

敲击术反制@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Azoh0BSoCASrA1lr]{固锁术}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.OSapCU8heNHst21y]{法术效果：敲击术}

You can attempt a Thievery check to open the target as part of casting knock, and you add your level even if you're untrained.

Knock counteracts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Azoh0BSoCASrA1lr]{Lock}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.OSapCU8heNHst21y]{Spell Effect: Knock}

items.name: 固锁术（随意）
items.description:
目标的锁扣咔哒合拢，被无形的魔法防护牢牢锁住。以魔法锁住目标时，你为打开它设定运动和贼活DC，等于你的法术DC或基础锁具DC加上+4状态加值，取较高者。在法术持续时间内，原本能打开这把锁的钥匙或密码均无法将其打开，但使用它们会使开门检定获得+4环境加值。如果目标被打开，法术结束。只要目标没有被其他方式闩住或锁住，你就可以花费一个交互动作触碰目标，将其解锁并打开；这不会结束法术。你可以在任何时间、任何距离解消该法术。

The target's latch mechanism clinks shut, held fast by unseen magical wards. When you magically lock a target, you set an Athletics and Thievery DC to open it equal to your spell DC or the base lock DC with a +4 status bonus, whichever is higher. Any key or combination that once opened a lock affected by this spell does not do so for the duration of the spell, though the key or combination does grant a +4 circumstance bonus to checks to open the door. If the target is opened, the spell ends. Assuming the target is not barred or locked in some additional way, you can unlock and open it with an Interact action during which you touch the target. This does not end the spell. You can Dismiss this spell at any time and from any distance.

Heightened (2nd) The duration is unlimited, but you must expend 60 credits worth of precious metals as an additional cost.

items.name: 修复术（随意）
items.description:
你修复目标物品。每有一环法术环阶，便为目标恢复5生命值；如果修复后超过物品的破损阈值，可能移除@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{破损}状态。你无法补回遗失的部件，也无法修复已被完全摧毁的物体。

升阶（2环）你能以负载不超过1的非魔法物体为目标。

升阶（3环）你能以负载不超过2的非魔法物体，或负载不超过1的魔法物体为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
You repair the target item. You restore 5 Hit Points per spell rank to the target, potentially removing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} condition if this repairs it past the item's Broken Threshold. You can't replace lost pieces or repair an object that's been completely destroyed.

Heightened (2nd) You can target a non-magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

Heightened (3rd) You can target a non-magical object of 2 Bulk or less, or a magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

U1as5NuyibdAKVvj.publicNotes:
大多数种类的精类生来便是自然现象的守护者，但有些却自诩为建筑或星舰等凡人造物的管家。船栖精是各种小型精类的统称，它们与星舰结契，主动承担照料和维护所选舰船的职责。它们通常以10至20名成员的家族群体生活。

船栖精经常被误认为是小魔怪，但这些隐居的精类对他人并无恶意。问题最常源于它们只忠于结契的舰船，通常完全不考虑该船真正的船员。它们不喜欢被人看见，会在船员身处别处时离开藏身处，修理和维护结契的舰船。

虽然船栖精能帮上忙，但它们往往将结契星舰内的一切视为己有。不知道船栖精存在的船员，经常会互相争吵，指责彼此偷窃物品、盗取口粮。此外，任何不尊重其结契舰船的人都会不断遭到骚扰，直到离舰或做出补偿；具体哪些行为算作不尊重，取决于有关的船栖精。

然而，能与船栖精群达成协议的船员——通常通过定期供奉食物或小饰物——往往拥有整个星系中运转最顺畅的星舰之一。

激增硬光故障体处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷}状态，持续至其回合结束，并能用额外动作行走或打击。

Pixelation The hardlight havoc is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from all creatures.

items.name: 备份
items.description:
数字幽灵的离线副本储存在一台设备中。活动中的数字幽灵被摧毁时，会在[[/gmr 2d4 #days]]{2d4天}后于储存副本的设备内重新成形，恢复全部生命值，却不记得是什么摧毁了自己。可以对抗数字幽灵的意志DC尝试@Check[computers|dc:24]检定，将它从该设备中永久移除。

成功时，数字幽灵的副本从设备中被清除，且不会再生成新副本。大成功时，任何活动中的副本也会被清除。

When an active digital ghost is destroyed, it reforms after [[/gmr 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} within the device that the copy is stored in, fully healed, but with no memory of what destroyed them. A digital ghost can be permanently removed from that device by attempting a @Check[computers|dc:24] check against the digital ghost's Will DC.

On a success, the copy of the digital ghost is purged from the device, and no new copies will be generated. On a critical success, any active copies are also purged.

items.name: 设备束缚
items.description: 数字幽灵研究员只能离开桑迪特档案库至多120尺。

频率每天一次

效果数字幽灵尝试感染30尺内一个生物持握或使用的、具有科技特征的物品。持有者可以进行@Check[will|dc:26]豁免。

大成功物品不受影响，数字幽灵在1周内不能使用恶意软件感染。

Frequency once per day

Effect The digital ghost attempts to infect an item with the tech trait being held or used by a creature within 30 feet. The bearer can attempt a @Check[will|dc:26] save.

Critical Success The item is unaffected, and the digital ghost can't use Malware Infection for 1 week.

items.name: 魅影灾祸
items.description:
末日毁灭的幻象充斥区域内每个生物的心智。幻象造成11d6心灵伤害，目标进行基础意志豁免。大失败时，该生物还必须通过@Check[reflex]豁免，否则会认为自己陷入困境，例如卡在裂缝中、漂泊海上，或遭遇符合其幻象的其他厄运。如果第二次豁免失败，它还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑}1分钟。它可以在自己的每回合结束时再次尝试意志豁免；成功时，它识破幻术并从震慑状态中恢复。

升阶（+1）伤害增加2d6。
items.expectedDescription:
A vision of apocalyptic destruction fills the mind of each creature in the area. The vision deals 11d6 mental damage (basic Will save). On a critical failure, the creature must also succeed at a @Check[reflex] save or believe it's trapped (stuck in a fissure, adrift at sea, or some other fate in keeping with its vision). If it fails the second save, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns, and on a success, it disbelieves the illusion and recovers from the stunned condition.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

items.name: 切割现实
items.description:
你划破现实，在一条20尺高、120尺长、2英寸厚的直线上形成一道能使生命流失的熵裂隙。裂隙提供掩蔽。裂隙会对在形成时位于其空间内、试图穿过裂隙或在裂隙内结束回合的每个生物造成7d8虚能伤害，具有一次基础反射豁免。如果生物在裂隙形成时豁免成功，则会被推到其选择的一侧最近的空间。试图穿过裂隙的生物如果豁免失败，就会在裂隙旁结束移动。

升阶（+1）伤害增加 1d8。
items.expectedDescription:
You slice through reality, forming a chasm of life-draining entropy in a straight line 20 feet high, 120 feet long, and 2 inches thick. The chasm provides cover. The chasm deals 7d8 void damage to each creature that's in the chasm's space when it's created, that attempts to pass through the chasm, or that ends its turn inside the chasm, with a basic Reflex save. A creature that succeeds at this save when the chasm is created is pushed to the nearest space on the side of its choice. Creatures trying to move through the chasm fail to do so if they critically fail the save, ending their movement next to the chasm.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.

items.name: 穿时推击
items.description:
你以极大力量推动一名生物穿过战场甚至让其在时间中滑动。尝试一次远程法术攻击，如果命中，你将目标直线向后击退15尺（重击则为30尺）。如果被推动的目标触碰到固体障碍或另一名生物，其便会停下。在其移动结束时，目标会重新回到时间流里并伴随时间能量的爆发。目标和现在邻接目标的生物必须尝试一次基础反射豁免否则便会受到7d8力场伤害。

升阶（+1）力场伤害增加1d8。
items.expectedDescription:
You push a creature across the battlefield so hard it slides through time. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, you knock the target back 15 feet in a straight line (30 feet on a critical hit). If the pushed creature makes contact with a solid barrier or another creature, its movement ends. At the end of this movement, the creature reenters the flow of time with a burst of temporal energy. The target and creatures now adjacent to the target take 7d8 force damage with a basic Reflex save.

Heightened (+1) The force damage increases by 1d8.

items.name: 精神质询
items.description:
你将思绪探入一个生物的心智，筛寻信息。除非目标以意志豁免抵御你，否则你可以读取其记忆与知识。

成功目标不受影响。

失败在法术持续时间的每一轮，你可以维持该法术，提出一个不同的问题并尝试发掘答案。对于每个问题，目标都可以尝试欺骗检定，对抗你的法术DC；成功时，你无法得知答案；大成功时，目标给出一个虚假答案，而你相信其为真。一旦向目标问过某个问题，再次询问同一问题都会得到相同结果，即使用另一次施放的精神质询也是如此。

大失败如同失败，且目标在对抗你的提问时的欺骗检定受到–4环境减值。
items.expectedDescription:
You cast your thoughts through a creature's mind, sifting for information. You access the target's memories and knowledge unless it fends you off with a Will save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure Each round of the spell's duration, you can Sustain the spell to ask a different question and attempt to uncover the answer. For each question, the target can attempt a Deception check against your spell DC; if the target succeeds, you don't learn the answer, and on a critical success, the target gives you a false answer that you believe is truthful Once you've asked the target a given question, asking it again, even with a separate casting of mind probe, produces the same result.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target takes a –4 circumstance penalty to Deception checks against your questions.

items.name: 短讯术
items.description: 你向该生物发送不超过25词的心灵信息，它可以立即用自己编写的一段不超过25词的信息回复。
items.expectedDescription: You send the creature a mental message of 25 words or fewer, and it can respond immediately with its own message of 25 words or fewer.

items.name: 神经脉冲
items.description:
你释放出一道搏动的精神冲击，穿透区域内所有敌人的心智。区域内每个敌人都必须尝试意志豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}状态。

失败该生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑2}状态。

大失败该生物震慑，持续1轮。
items.expectedDescription:
You emit a pulsating mental blast that penetrates the minds of all enemies in the area. Each enemy in the area must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is Stunned for 1 round.

items.name: 法术解除结界
items.description:
你在自己周围创造一个不可移动的球体。对于从球外施放且区域或目标进入球内的任何法术，球体都会尝试反制，视为比其实际法术环级低1环的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}法术。

如果反制尝试成功，只会阻止将要进入球体的那部分法术。因此，如果法术还有球外的目标，或部分区域位于球外，那些目标或区域仍会正常受到影响。

你必须在连续的开放空间内形成球体，使其边缘不穿过任何生物或物体，否则便会失去该法术。不过，施放后生物可以进入球体。
items.expectedDescription:
You create an immobile globe around yourself that attempts to counteract any spell from outside the globe whose area or targets enter into the globe, as if the globe were a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} spell 1 rank lower than its actual spell rank.

If the counteract attempt succeeds, it prevents only the portion of the spell that would have entered the globe (so if the spell also has targets outside the globe, or part of its area is beyond the globe, those targets or that area is affected normally).

You must form the sphere in an unbroken open space, so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost (though creatures can enter the globe after the spell is cast).

items.name: 岁月重担
items.description:
你将目标毕生的苦痛与哀伤化作沉重枷锁，压垮目标的身心。尝试一次远程法术攻击骰。目标受到3d8钝击伤害和3d8心灵，并且必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标受到一半伤害。

失败目标受到全伤害并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]1轮。

大失败目标受到全伤害并且超载1分钟。

升阶（+1）心灵伤害增加2d8
items.expectedDescription:
You burden a creature's body and mind with the pains and sorrows of a lifetime. The target takes 3d8 bludgeoning damage and 3d8 mental damage and must attempt a Will saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is encumbered for 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The mental damage increases by 2d8.

items.name: 诡枪术
items.description:
你从群星之间的黑暗虚空中凝聚一束侵袭心灵的诡异能量，射向目标。对抗目标的AC进行远程法术攻击检定。命中时，你造成2d6心灵伤害。大成功时，你造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。
items.expectedDescription:
You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

items.name: 念动之手
items.description:
你创造一只悬浮的魔法手掌，它可以隐形或呈幽灵状，抓住目标物体，使其缓缓向任意方向浮动至多20尺。维持法术时，你能将物体再移动20尺。如果法术结束时物体仍在空中，它便会坠落。

升阶（3环）你能以一件无人持有且负载不超过1的物体为目标。

升阶（5环）射程提高至60尺，且你能以一件无人持有、负载不超过1的物体为目标。

升阶（7环）射程提高至60尺，且你能以一件无人持有、负载不超过2的物体为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

items.name: 念动射弹
items.description:
你将射程内一件未固定、无人持有且负载不超过1的物体掷向目标。对目标进行法术攻击检定。命中时，你造成2d6钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害，取决于所掷物体。被掷物品的任何特殊特征或魔法属性，都不会影响此次攻击或伤害。

大成功你造成双倍伤害。

成功你造成完整伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。
items.expectedDescription:
You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

items.name: 运动感知
items.expectedDescription: A vedzax can sense nearby creatures through vibrations in air or water caused by movement as an imprecise sense at the listed range.
items.description: 水晶虫能在所列范围内以模糊感官通过空气或水中由运动引起的震动感知附近生物。

items.name: 桑迪特虹吸
items.expectedDescription: The szandite crystal structure on a glibraiaxʼs body provides it with near-perfect memory and lightning-fast linguistic processing. items.description: 水晶虫身上的桑迪特水晶结构赋予其近乎完美的记忆和闪电般的语言处理能力。水晶虫可以永久读写进入其心灵感应范围内生物所知的所有语言，并能完美回忆其经历的所有事件、对话和思想。

items.description: （灵光） 30尺。所有处于彼此范围内的虫群心智盟友能够进行持续的心灵沟通，并且彼此知道对方察觉到的所有威胁。如果此生物处于至少一个具有虫群心智的盟友的范围内，则其在对抗心灵效果的豁免上掷骰出成功时，改为获得大成功。

wziq0WDzyCW3WgNG.publicNotes:
长冠达洛克兽是原产于罗德纳斯沼泽湿地的巨型爬行野兽。达洛克兽独居且领地意识强烈，一年中大部分时间都在浑浊的沼泽中游泳、晒太阳，避免接触同类。然而，它们每年都会暂时放下独居习性，组成庞大的兽群，深入沼泽寻找有遮蔽的水域，作为产卵池。

迁徙期间，达洛克兽通过展示敏捷与力量寻找合适的伴侣。雌雄双方都会通过舞蹈、赛跑以及复杂的鸣叫表演展示自身的健壮。达洛克兽之间真正的暴力冲突极为罕见，大多数争执只需快速闪动音波冠或发出一声强力尖啸便能解决。如果竞争升级为肢体攻击，族母便会带领兽群唱起悠远而轻柔的歌声，恢复和平。

兽群受到威胁或失去族母时，达洛克兽能造成惊人的破坏。在整个星球禁止偷猎达洛克兽族母之前，每年都有许多聚落经常被达洛克兽群的奔踏夷为平地。

1lHcDkOwQTJBvEhn.name: 贪食干扰虫集群 Ravenous Szynegator Swarm
1lHcDkOwQTJBvEhn.publicNotes:
单只干扰虫的振动只会造成轻微眩晕，但当这些微小的甲虫状虫群成员同调时，产生的大气扰动会使大多数通讯方式失效。干扰虫通常出现在行星上偏僻或荒凉的地区，以便不受阻碍地增加数量。它们的出现预示着虫群即将全面入侵。

虫群由浩界深处一种称为虫族的虫类物种演化而来，被数种文明视为现存最大的威胁。虫群由无数子群组成，每个子群又包含无数成员亚种；这支庞大群体以心灵联合行动，意图吞噬宇宙中的所有物质。最可怕的是，虫群能够同化被吞噬者的知识与DNA。虫群在大断层前就已发展出星际旅行，因此在历史中断之前便已吞噬无数星系；获得信标和名为漂流域的超空间维度的使用途径后，它们扩张的速度只增不减。

虫群触及的世界会被榨干自然资源，沦为称作空壳世界的荒芜之地。外界所谓的“虫群疆域”，不过是虫群肆意扩张过程中吞噬的一片死寂世界。虫群对这些世界搜刮得如此彻底，以至于勘察者连稀有矿物和水等无机资源的痕量残留都难以找到。这些空壳世界很少被彻底探索，因为探索往往会唤醒休眠的虫群成员；有人推测，它们被留下是为了应对被吞噬星系再次遭到殖民、重新繁荣的可能。虫群活动的零星区域远在这片宙域之外也有分布，因为虫群在大断层前的漫长岁月里曾派出无数子群，直到今日，也只有一部分抵达了预定目的地。

在当代，虫群最广为人知的或许是两个重要事实。其一，它们对协约世界与维斯卡里姆的进攻，促使这两大势力停止敌对，并建立了脆弱的联盟。其二，虫群是希伦虫人物种的直系祖先。希伦虫人在大断层期间的某个时候脱离虫群，并得到了女神海拉丝的庇护。人们认为，海拉丝由虫群出现前的虫族演化而来，并背弃了虫群演化成的贪食实体。

近些年来，除了在浩界的苏斯基隆星系开展的机密行动之外，虫群几乎没有活动，因而被视为遥远的恐怖传说。然而，最近失落的桑迪特世界克雷西斯卡被重新发现，却无意间唤醒了曾吞噬该世界、随后休眠的子群。从那以后，这支新命名为克雷西斯卡子群的虫群便成为近宇的灾祸，正积极入侵桑迪特联合体的各个世界，并随时可能波及维斯卡里姆和协约世界等其他势力。重新现身的子群已开始迅速演化其成员，且仍与更广大的虫群隔绝，但依然对近宇构成明确威胁。

cnText_system_details_description.text: 魔法科技传送法阵上凸起的符文发光迸火，充斥失控魔力。碎石和其他无人持有的物体在房内随机传送。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[arcana|dc:25] to restabilize the teleportation pad, @Check[crafting|dc:25] or @Check[thievery|dc:25] to disable the hazard by hand, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (4th rank; counteract DC 22) to counteract the effect; the ambient magic burns out and the hazard automatically disables after 1 minute
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[arcana|dc:25]以重新稳定传送台；@Check[crafting|dc:25]或@Check[thievery|dc:25]以手动解除危害；或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}（4环；反制DC 22）以反制效果；1分钟后，环境魔力耗尽，危害自动解除

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) Each creature within 50 feet of the teleporter must attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save; on a failure, the target is teleported 10 feet in a random direction (but not through walls). This effect has the teleportation trait.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）传送器50尺内的每个生物都必须尝试@Check[will|dc:25]豁免；失败时，目标向随机方向传送10尺，但不会穿墙。此效果具有传送特征。

items.name: 电震
items.description:
触发一个生物触碰门

效果陷阱对触发生物及其周围5尺内的生物造成@Damage[7d8[electricity]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:27|basic]豁免）。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature touches the door

Effect The trap deals @Damage[7d8[electricity]] damage to the triggering creature and creatures within 5 feet of the triggering creature (@Check[reflex|dc:27|basic] save).

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A door latch is wired to an external power grid, rigged to release a powerful electrical charge.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 门锁扣连接着外部电网，被设置为释放强大电荷。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[crafting|dc:19] (trained) or @Check[thievery|dc:21] (trained) to disconnect the power line

SvFm1jZNZQWwUL1T.name: 有毒废气排放口 Toxic Exhaust Vents

items.name: 释放纳米机器人
items.description:
触发两名或更多玩家角色进入房间，或在房间内结束其回合

效果陷阱对每个触发生物进行废气羽流打击，然后投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger Two or more PCs enter the room or end their turn in the room

Effect The trap makes an exhaust plume Strike against each triggering creature, then rolls initiative.

items.name: 压迫废气
items.description:
触发房间内的一个生物结束其回合

效果陷阱对触发生物进行废气羽流打击。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within the room ends its turn

Effect The trap makes an exhaust plume Strike against the triggering creature.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: In an effort to dispose of the PCs, the szynegation hub reroutes its exhaust systems to pump toxic fumes into this room.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 干扰中枢为除掉PC，重新引导排气系统，将有毒烟气灌入房间。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[athletics|dc:24] to plug the vents with nearby debris, @Check[crafting|dc:22] (trained) or @Check[thievery|dc:22] (trained) on the vent to deactivate the trap, or @Check[computers|dc:24] (trained) to Hack and reverse the flow of exhaust. There are two vents in this room. Once both have been disabled, the toxic fumes clear after 3 rounds. While these fumes persist, PCs need to hold their breath or rely on environmental protections in their armor; otherwise, they risk suffocating on the toxic fumes.
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[athletics|dc:24]以附近碎屑堵住排气口；对排气口进行@Check[crafting|dc:22]（受训）或@Check[thievery|dc:22]（受训）以停用陷阱；或@Check[computers|dc:24]（受训）以骇入并逆转排气流向。房内有两个排气口。两者均被解除后，毒烟会在3轮后散去。毒烟存在期间，PC需要屏息或依靠护甲的环境防护，否则可能因毒烟窒息。

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) The trap launches exhaust plume strikes against every creature in the room as 1 action. Because it launches exhaust continuously, the trap can also use the Oppressive Exhaust free action (see below) against each creature during that creature's turn.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）陷阱用一个动作，对房内每个生物进行废气羽流打击。由于持续喷出废气，陷阱还可以在每个生物的回合使用压迫废气自由动作，影响该生物，见下文。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute.

TZtbm06kNXO8Nwbe.name: 设有炸弹的头盔 Rigged Helmet

items.name: 引爆
items.description:
触发德米或伊戈引爆炸弹

效果炸弹爆炸，造成@Damage[10d6[fire]]伤害，范围为@Template[burst|distance:15]{15尺半径}（@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic]）。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger Demmi or Igo detonates the bomb

Effect The bomb explodes, dealing @Damage[10d6[fire]] damage in a @Template[burst|distance:15]{15-foot radius} (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic]).

cnText_system_details_description.expected:
This helmet is clearly a Stewards standard-issue light infantry model that appears to have been damaged in combat. PCs who succeed at the check to notice the hazard discover exposed wires protruding from the neck and that the nearby szynegator is tethered in place by a cable driven through a hole drilled in the creature's chitin. PCs who critically succeed at their Perception check realize the bomb is designed to be manually triggered.

Either Demmi or Igo remotely detonates the bomb in the event at least half the party is within range. If a PC attempts to disable the bomb and fails, Igo or Demmi immediately detonates it, even if fewer than half the PCs would be caught in the area.
cnText_system_details_description.text:
这顶头盔显然是理事军制式轻步兵型号，看起来在战斗中受过损伤。PC成功通过发现危害的检定时，会发现颈部伸出的裸露电线，以及附近的干扰虫被一根穿过甲壳钻孔的缆线固定在原地。PC察觉检定大成功时，会意识到炸弹被设计为手动引爆。

至少半数队伍处于范围内时，德米或伊戈会远程引爆炸弹。如果PC尝试解除炸弹失败，即使影响区域内不足半数PC，伊戈或德米也会立即引爆。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[crafting|dc:28] or @Check[thievery|dc:28] to disarm the bomb, or @Check[computers|dc:28] to disrupt the detonation signal
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[crafting|dc:28]或@Check[thievery|dc:28]以拆除炸弹；或@Check[computers|dc:28]以干扰引爆信号

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: Special If the bomb detonates, it kills the captured szynegator. This can be avoided if a PC within 5 feet willingly fails their Reflex saving throw against the bomb to shield the szynegator.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: 特殊炸弹引爆会杀死被俘的干扰虫。5尺内一名PC可以自愿让自己对抗炸弹的反射豁免失败，掩护干扰虫，从而避免其死亡。

items.name: 电涌
items.description:
触发一个生物触碰或尝试启动工程模块内的一个控制台

效果紫色电流在所有控制台的屏幕和键盘间噼啪作响。一道电弧射向某个控制台周围10尺内一个随机生物，造成@Damage[(2d8+5)[electricity]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic]豁免）。该危害投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature touches or attempts to activate one of the consoles in the engineering module

Effect Purple electricity crackles across the screens and keyboards of all the consoles. A jolt arcs to one random creature within 10 feet of a console, dealing @Damage[(2d8+5)[electricity]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save). The hazard rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Surging electricity from the damaged power core has charged the consoles in this module with magical electricity, which arcs toward any creature that gets too close to the core.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 损坏动力核心涌出的电流，使此舱段的控制台充满魔法电力，并向所有过于接近核心的生物放电。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[crafting|dc:22] (trained) or @Check[Physical Science Lore|dc:18] (trained) to safely ground the electricity, @Check[arcana|dc:22] (trained) or Occultism (trained) to redirect the magical component of the electricity, or @Check[crafting|dc:25] to improvise equipment to safely manipulate the console; three total successes are needed to disable the hazard
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[crafting|dc:22]（受训）或@Check[Physical Science Lore|dc:18]（受训）以安全接地放电；@Check[arcana|dc:22]（受训）或神秘（受训）以引导电流中的魔法成分；或@Check[crafting|dc:25]以临时拼制设备，安全操作控制台；解除危害总计需要三次成功

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (2 actions) The surging electricity arcs from the consoles to up to two creatures within 10 feet, dealing @Damage[(2d8+5)[electricity]] damage to each (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save).
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （2个动作）涌动的电流从控制台跃向10尺内至多两个生物，对每个生物造成@Damage[(2d8+5)[electricity]]伤害，目标进行@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic]豁免。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The fluctuating power core recharges the electricity surging through the consoles after 1 minute, after which the hazard can trigger again. Repairing the power core permanently disables the hazard.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 不稳定的动力核心在1分钟后重新为控制台充电，之后危害可以再次触发。修复动力核心会永久解除危害。

pTiO6E1mqrJXfuWJ.name: 桑迪特潜猎虫 Szandite Stalker

items.name: 心灵拟声
items.description: 桑迪特潜猎虫能完美模仿曾观察到其说话的生物的声音，并通过桑迪特水晶，以心灵方式将此声音投射给100尺内的任何生物。与潜猎虫以这种方式交流的任何生物，都必须成功通过@Check[will|dc:23]豁免，否则会信以为真。
items.expectedDescription: A szandite stalker can perfectly mimic the voice of a creature it has observed speaking and can project this voice psychically via its szandite crystals to any creatures within 100 feet. Any creature the stalker communicates with in this manner must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:23] save or believe the mimicry to be true.

items.name: 协同狩猎
items.description:
桑迪特潜猎虫尝试打击一个大型或更小的目标后（无论成功还是失败），潜猎虫的一名盟友对同一目标进行的下一次打击，其攻击检定获得+2环境加值。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.bestiary-effects.Item.P0PjncVUqsdDFfhv]
items.expectedDescription:
After the szandite stalker attempts a Strike at a Large or smaller target (regardless of success or failure), the next Strike one of the stalker's allies makes against the same target gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.bestiary-effects.Item.P0PjncVUqsdDFfhv]

items.name: 猎杀目标
items.description: 桑迪特潜猎虫指定一个能看见且听见的生物，或一个正在追踪的生物作为猎物。桑迪特潜猎虫进行[[/act seek]]猎物的察觉检定和[[/act track]]猎物的生存检定时，获得+2环境加值。桑迪特潜猎虫每轮首次命中指定猎物时，额外造成1d8精准伤害。这些效应持续至桑迪特潜猎虫再次使用猎杀目标。
items.expectedDescription: The szandite stalker designates a single creature they can see and hear, or one they're Tracking, as their prey. The szandite stalker gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act seek]] the prey and to Survival checks to [[/act track]] the prey. The first time the szandite stalker hits their designated prey in a round, they deal an additional 1d8 precision damage. These effects last until the szandite stalker uses Hunt Prey again.

items.name: 滑行斩击
items.description: 桑迪特潜猎虫行走两次，每次都沿直线移动。每次行走期间，它都能在移动途中的任意时点，对触及内一个生物进行一次刃肢打击；两次攻击必须以不同生物为目标，但两次打击都结束后才适用多次攻击减值。
items.expectedDescription: The szandite stalker Strides twice, each time in a straight line. Once per Stride, it can attempt a bladed limb Strike against a creature in its reach at any point during its movement; it must make each attack against a different creature, but it doesn't apply its multiple attack penalty until after making both Strikes.

rzkFYGr1EsvJUWAI.name: 远古安保措施 Ancient Security Measures

items.name: 启动安保措施
items.description:
触发一个生物使用区域攻击，例如手榴弹或影响区域的法术，并波及行星表面

效果区域效应落点周围100尺内的每个生物脚下都出现一个陷坑。每个生物必须进行@Check[reflex|dc:28]豁免。如果该危害尚未投掷先攻，则此时投掷先攻。

成功该生物避免落入陷坑，改为移动至自行选择的一个相邻空位。

失败该生物被拉入陷坑并开始下沉。它处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}状态，直到成功通过解除该危害的检定使自己脱困。如果一个生物连续被困2轮，便沉入地下，必须屏息，否则开始窒息。相邻生物可以通过成功的@Check[athletics|dc:30]检定解救一个被困生物。

大失败如同失败，但该生物改为处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{受擒}状态而非禁足，且立即被拉入地下，必须屏息，否则开始窒息。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature uses an area attack, such as a grenade or spell that affects an area, that impacts the planet's surface

Effect A sinkhole opens beneath each creature within 100 feet of the area effect's impact. Each creature must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:28] save. The hazard then rolls initiative if it hasn't already.

Success The creature avoids falling into a sinkhole and instead moves to an adjacent empty space of its choice.

Failure The creature is pulled into a sinkhole and begins sinking. It's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} until it frees itself with a successful check to disable the hazard. If a creature is stuck for 2 consecutive rounds, it sinks beneath the surface and must hold its breath or begin suffocating. An adjacent creature can free a stuck creature with a successful @Check[athletics|dc:30] check.

Critical Failure As failure, except the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} instead of immobilized, and it's immediately pulled underground and must hold its breath or begin suffocating.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: An ancient security system triggers and initiates a localized attack on detected hostiles. A noise somewhere between the rumbling of rock and the blare of an automated alarm system envelops the area as the ground begins to shake. Unnaturally precise sinkholes open beneath everyone nearby
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一个古老安保系统触发，对侦测到的敌对者发动局部攻击。地面开始震动，介于岩石轰鸣与自动警报之间的声音笼罩区域。附近每个人脚下都出现了精准得不自然的陷坑

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[athletics|dc:28] to forcibly climb out to an adjacent square, @Check[acrobatics|dc:28] to nimbly squeeze out of a sinkhole to an adjacent square; the sinkholes are permanent, and creatures that later enter the space of a sinkhole must attempt a Reflex save as if targeted by Activate Security Measures (see below)
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[athletics|dc:28]以强行爬出至相邻方格；@Check[acrobatics|dc:28]以灵巧地挤出陷坑至相邻方格；陷坑永久存在，之后进入其空间的生物必须尝试反射豁免，如同成为激活安保措施的目标，见下文

cnText_system_details_routine.expected:
(1 action) On the hazard's initiative, each sinkhole crushes each creature within it with gravitational forces from the planet's core. Affected creatures take @Damage[5d8[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] save).

Special If any of the Stewards are pulled underground due to this complication and then freed by the PCs, the Stewards surrender and consent to be remanded to the proper authorities.
cnText_system_details_routine.text:
（1个动作）在危害的先攻轮次，每个陷坑以来自行星核心的引力挤压其中的每个生物。受影响生物受到@Damage[5d8[bludgeoning]]伤害，并进行@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic]豁免。

特殊如果任何理事军因这场意外被拉入地下，随后获PC救出，他们会投降，同意被移交适当的当局。
